report.summary: One action_required finding: the control 'idle session expiry' is still marked implemented = true but this PR deletes the 30-minute idle timeout enforcement from internal/session/expiry.go.

findings.title: Control 'idle session expiry' is marked implemented but the timeout enforcement was deleted

model_excerpt.quote: control "idle session expiry" implemented=true — Sessions idle for more than 30 minutes are rejected and the customer must sign in again, enforced on every request in internal/session/expiry.go

evidence.note: Post-change Expiry middleware only refreshes LastSeen; no idle-timeout comparison, no session deletion, no 401 response remains
s.LastSeen = time.Now() is now unconditional, so an indefinitely idle session stays valid and is simply re-stamped on each request

Doc comment rewritten from 'rejects sessions that have been idle for longer than idleTimeout' to 'records activity on the request's session', and the idleTimeout constant (30 * time.Minute) was removed by this PR

relevance.justification: The model names this exact file as the enforcement point and the diff removes the entire enforcement branch, so the implemented = true claim is now false.

findings.agent_prompt: In threatmodels/storefront.tm.hcl, threat "session hijacking" contains control "idle session expiry" with implemented = true and a description claiming "Sessions idle for more than 30 minutes are rejected and the customer must sign in again, enforced on every request in internal/session/expiry.go". This PR rewrote internal/session/expiry.go: the idleTimeout constant (30 * time.Minute), the time.Since(s.LastSeen) > idleTimeout check, the store.Delete(s.ID) call and the 401 "session expired" response were all deleted; the middleware now only stamps s.LastSeen and calls next.ServeHTTP. Set implemented = false on that control and update its description to state that expiry is no longer enforced (the middleware only records last-seen activity), or, if expiry moved elsewhere, repoint the description at the new enforcement location and cite it. Leave the rest of the file unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Set implemented = false on control "idle session expiry" in threatmodels/storefront.tm.hcl and reword its description to drop the 30-minute rejection claim.
